description: The additive Bedrock 2.1.0 changes to contract/bedrock-v2.yaml and contract/bedrock-v2.schema.json (migrations/v2.0.1-to-v2.1.0.md). Each entry is a path, its exact 2.1.0 value, and the 2.0 value it replaced; an entry without a baseline was added. Native replay retracts exactly these against the pinned 2.0 receiver; any other value at these paths, or any other difference, fails.

contract.added: Candidate, Promise and Gap ids, each once
contract.baseline: Candidate and Promise ids, each once

contract.added: nothing; a Plan assigns nothing by existing, as recording a Gap assigns nothing
a Plan holds only Candidates, Promises and Gaps, each once; a regroup removes only what the Plan holds; a waits_on link names only members
contract.baseline: a Plan holds only Candidates and Promises, each once; a regroup removes only what the Plan holds; a waits_on link names only members

contract.added: an Invariant or Promise that names a version scope is made at system level in that scope; a making act or an amendment that names another scope is refused
Invariants stipulated (neither superseded nor revoked) that apply to the scope - those recorded at the scope or at any scope it reaches by belongs_to, a version scope and the organisation included.
contract.baseline: Invariants stipulated (neither superseded nor revoked) for the scope and every scope it is related to by belongs_to.

added.version_scope: a system-level scope naming a version, such as agent-runtime/2; the making act has level system and that scope

added.authority: the situation domain - the act log and its projection
added.repository_directory: a repository's situation/ directory is where its records are authored only until the domain holds them

projection.public_repository: one generated file, rebuilt on every merge
projection.content: a header, then one section per record class in id order
projection.source: never; a projection is never a source

repository_instructions.agents_md: the root AGENTS.md repository block is one fixed text, templates/repository-block.md
repository_instructions.pinned_to: the protocol version the repository adopts

added.description: The Bedrock language version the act was recorded under; 2.1.0 is additive, so acts recorded under 2.0.0 stay valid.

What an Invariant or Promise binds: all environments (the default when absent) or a version scope, a system-level scope such as agent-runtime/2. In the domain it is the making act's level and scope; in a record file it is the heading Applies to.
A Plan member: a Candidate, a Promise or a Gap, nothing else.

baseline.description: A Plan member: a Candidate or a Promise, nothing else.
